verdict.rationale: Martin supports several recurring scheduled behaviors out of the box — daily/weekly briefings, daily wake-up calls, and reminders — plus multi-step 'shortcuts' for custom actions, which together resemble recurring workflow automation. However, there's no evidence of a general-purpose recurring job scheduler (e.g., 'run this shortcut every Monday') beyond the fixed built-in cadences. Missing for 10: user-defined custom recurrence/scheduling for arbitrary workflows, independent confirmation that shortcuts can be scheduled repeatedly, and any UI/API for managing recurring jobs.
